get_departures.description: Read the live departure board for a station: every train due, how many minutes away it is, which platform and direction it leaves from, how many cars it has, whether it takes bikes and how late it is running. BART groups its estimates by destination, so they are flattened here into one row per train and sorted by how soon it goes, which makes departures[0] the next train out whatever line it is on. A train at the platform reports 0 minutes with leaving_now set, rather than the word BART sends. Filter by platform, direction or both to narrow the board, or pick 'Every station (ALL)' to read the whole system in one request. When there is nothing due, the departures list is empty and BART's own explanation is in warning.

transfer_count.description: How many times the traveller changes trains. 0 is a direct journey. Counted here: BART sends only the legs.

description: Read the Bay Area's rail network through BART's free, keyless public API: live departure boards with delays and platforms, service advisories and elevator outages, how many trains are running right now, the station and route directories with each station's access details, published timetables for a station or a whole line, and trip planning with platforms and fares in every class. No account or API key is required. Disclaimer: this is an independent integration built on BART's public API. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by the San Francisco Bay Area Rapid Transit District; BART and its marks are the property of that district.
